g.text: Each spoke = one city; each ring = one Target pair. Pair order is identical in both countries.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #747d85

g.text: Inner to outer: 22 pairs stable in both countries, 20 in NSF only, 20 in NSFC only; black arcs mark boundaries.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #747d85

g.text: Trees use binary Jaccard distance and average linkage; branches indicate similarity, not collaboration.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #747d85

g.text: Selected rings are labelled with their Target codes. All 62 pairs, city names and coverage counts are in the index.
